title: Deloitte: Romania remains among Europe’s cheapest housing markets despite 14% price rise in 2025
summary: Romania ranked fourth among the European countries with the lowest housing prices in 2025, behind Turkey, Serbia, and Albania, according to Deloitte’s Property Index 2026. This was the largest increase among the countries analysed, followed by Croatia at 14.3%, Slovakia at 12.5%, and Hungary at 10.9%. Prices increased in 19 of the 22 countries for which national data was available.
